description: A geometry library for engineering drawings and models, in two dimensions and in three. Points, vectors, lines, polylines, polygons, faces with holes, circles and oriented rectangles in the plane; points, planes, triangles, polygons, faces, solids, boxes, coordinate systems and transformations in space. Over both: distance, projection, containment, intersection, collision, parallelism, parametrization, merging, splitting, extending and trimming, offsetting, and boolean operations. It also reads, writes and edits DXF drawings with AutoCAD's names, carries the label placement that arranges drawing labels clear of each other and of blocked regions, and packs boxes such as drawing views onto sheets of paper. Every comparison is tolerance-aware, because coordinates that come out of a BIM model are never exact.
releaseNotes:
NEW IN 13.1.0

      FIXED, speed of curved booleans and take-offs
      - The booleans of two curved bodies faceted at different stations, and VolumeTakeoff of them, no longer run for
        minutes. Once a body is cut into more than 4 096 cells, and where both bodies and their openings close, a plane
        of the other cuts a cell only near the faces lying on that plane. A spiral ramp and a spiral girder faceted 56
        and 66 times were cut into 263 911 cells and took 91 seconds on .NET Framework 4.8; they are cut into 18 345
        and take 3.3, and their take-off 3.0 where it took 90, at the volume slicing gives. Booleans of bodies cut into
        no more than 4 096 cells give what they gave, to the bit.
      - A difference or union whose one body, cut only near the planes, came out open and did not add up sealed is no
        longer taken welded closed all the same: a ramp less a girder whose top lay 0.002 over the ramp's floor came
        out an eighth of their common part short and trusted; it is not worked out now, and the take-off slices it.

      FIXED, booleans and queries
      - A difference could leave a concave cell whole where planes of the other ran through it and trust what it
        gave; such cells are read by the parts every crossing plane makes together.
      - TryCutOpenings at a tolerance below the rounding of the coordinates no longer returns true with a body left
        open or wrong.
      - At a tolerance of nought, a segment or a line without ends finds its crossing of a triangle or a face turned
        about in space, and of every face of a body it passes through.
      - The distance from a curved chain or loop in space to a point is measured to each straight edge as it is,
        however short, as it is in the plane.

      FIXED, DXF
      - DxfDatabase.WblockCloneObjects, and an INSERT of another drawing copied by AppendEntity, are refused with an
        ArgumentException, writing nothing, where the copy would come to insert itself.

      CHANGED
      - IsClosed reads a body as Validate reads it, so the two agree on every body but a speck.
      - Offsetting a curved loop cut at its crossings into many loops no longer slows with the square of them.
        Results are the same to the bit.

      Details in CHANGELOG.md.

      Earlier releases: https://github.com/nguyenthanguth/GeometryHelper/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md
